portInfo.description: Trondheim Port Authority (TPA) operates ISPS cruise facilities in Trondheim. Cruise quay 68 at Brattøra is published at 96 m length and 13 m depth and has received large ships including Queen Mary 2 and MSC Meraviglia. Ila 30 (280 m / 8 m) is used when 68 is unavailable; Pir 1 appears in the cruise quay table with afternoon availability notes. Anchored ships may tender to the Skansen floating bridge (~1300 m from anchorage per 2026 terms). The port terms sheet cites up to four cruise ships and 9,000 passengers per day.

facts.established: Founded in 997 AD as a trading post
facts.significance: Historical capital of Norway during Viking Age

climate.description: Coastal climate with cool summers and mild winters

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality. Many visitors use Schengen short-stay rules, but requirements change—confirm with official government sources and your cruise line before travel.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID where your cruise line and destination authorities accept it). Cruise transit formalities can differ from a normal airport entry—follow your ship’s document list.

gettingThere.walkingTime: 15-20 minutes to city center—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Cruise berths are centrally located for city exploring. Confirm whether you start from Brattøra (quay 68) or Ila — walk times differ. Prefer your ship’s pier map for the gangway you use.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Trondheim city centre / Nidaros area (destination framing)
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm Quay 68 vs Ila 30 vs Skansen tender before planning walk times.
